Jared (Marketing Ops): Quick sync 10m1 1Jun virtual lab is green. Need reg page, Zoom + SRT pipeline, A/B reg-copy test, and post-event gating flow locked by Fri 5pm. Key asks: two CTAs, company-size routing, video chapters & auto-clips, 12d open replay then gated, and privacy/consent handling.
Kali (Growth): A/B test idea: variant A = concise hero + bullet agenda; variant B = social proof + one short customer quote. We'll route 50/50 via query param ?variant=b. Keep form <=6 fields.
Remi (Design): Uploaded both variants to Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/virtual-lab-ab/variants. I added mobile-first rules and the hero microcopy.
Jared (Marketing Ops): Form fields: first_name, last_name, email, company, company_size (<50 / 50-500 / 500+), role, gdpr_consent (required). Hidden fields: source_detail=virtual_lab_jun21, ab_variant. Add ICS + Google Calendar buttons.
Sam (Events): Zoom plan: cloud recording + audio transcript ON, enable "Optimize for 3rd party captions" for SRT output. We'll also stream an SRT feed to our ingestion: srt://ingest.redwood.example:9033/lab21. Local host recording enabled as fallback.
ZoomBot: Meeting created https://zoom.us/j/2223334445 (ID: 222-333-4445). SRT test scheduled Jun 19 09:00 PT.
Kali (Growth): HubSpot mapping: lead_source, event_name, company_size_segment, source_detail, ab_variant. Routing: company_size==500+ -> ae-queue; else -> sdr-queue. Add property "attended_live" boolean via Zoom webhook (joined > 5 min).
Remi (Design): New ask: we want video chapters metadata (0:00 intro, 5:00 demo, 22:00 Q&A). Sam can you ensure timestamps captured so we can publish chapter markers with the replay? Also clip poster frames: need 3 crop sizes + speaker headshots.
Sam (Events): Yep. I'll run timecode notes live and mark chapter timestamps in the session doc. Auto-clip plan: post-process SRT + chapter markers to detect top questions and create 60-90s highlight clips. I'll push raw assets to s3://redwood-events/virtual-lab-2026/ then a processed folder with clips and VTT.
Nina (Legal): Privacy/GDPR/CCPA: consent checkbox required. Add sample consent copy: "Yes, I agree to receive event-related communications from Redwood Inference and understand my data will be used to improve event experience." Add opt-out link and retention policy note: recordings copied to S3 and public for 12 days, then moved to gated bucket for 90 days with signed URLs. Save consent boolean to HS property 'gdpr_consent'.
Kali (Growth): A/B analytics: capture ab_variant in HS and GA. We'll run the split for signups only; measure conversion to attend and demo-booking. KPI: 15% lift to demo requests on variant B.
Jared (Marketing Ops): Replay policy: day 0-12 public open replay URL. Day 13 -> gated: require email to unlock full download + chaptered VOD. Clips remain public. Also plan a Slack AMA 48h after for registrants; we'll link to AMA thread in the follow-up.
Sam (Events): Infra note: SRT endpoint uses port 9033; infra confirmed for Zoom IP ranges. I'll run SRT smoke test Jun 19 and full dress rehearsal Jun 20 10:00 PT. ZoomBot: smoke test scheduled Jun 19 09:00 PT; dress rehearsal Jun 20 10:00 PT.
Remi (Design): Thumbnails delivery ETA: Jun 18 EOD. Provide speaker headshots and alt text. We'll include a small badge on thumbnails that says "Highlight" for clips.
Kali (Growth): Post-event cadence: 0-24h - open replay + CTA to book demo; 48h - Slack AMA invite + highlight clips; Day 7 - nurture to attendees; Day 13 - gated full download + long-form follow-up to registrants who didn't attend. AE alert for 500+ attendees with conversation starter: "interested in production inference for latency/cost".
Jared (Marketing Ops): CSV fields for ops export: email, first_name, last_name, company, company_size_segment, ab_variant, utm_campaign, registration_ts, session_id, attended_live. Daily sync to HS.
Nina (Legal): Add CCPA opt-out link in footer and a short line in the reg form: "You can opt out any time; see our privacy policy." Also ensure vendor processors (S3, Zoom) are contracted.
Sam (Events): Clip ownership: Sam -> extract clips and timecodes; Kali -> titles & CTAs; Remi -> thumbnails; Jared -> upload and schedule distribution. If SRT fails, fallback to cloud transcript VTT and local host recording.
Kali (Growth): Small request: tag registrants who convert to demo with property "demo_interest_level" (low/medium/high) based on form role + question. We'll map high -> AE immediately.
Jared (Marketing Ops): Devs: include validation for company_employee_count hidden numeric field. Hidden field 'ab_variant' set by query param or server-side split. Also make sure form prevents bot signups (simple captcha).
Remi (Design): Minor copy tweak: variant B adds a one-line customer quote under hero and moves bullets to the right column. I'll deliver final art by Jun 17 3pm.
Sam (Events): Lock reg page + email templates by Jun 18 12pm PT so I can test webhooks and SRT.
Jared (Marketing Ops): Ownership recap: Jared = reg page + HS fields + Asana tasks; Remi = design + thumbs; Sam = Zoom + SRT + clips + S3; Kali = growth + A/B + workflows; Nina = legal sign-off. React with :white_check_mark: when your Asana task is complete.
Kali (Growth): :white_check_mark:
Remi (Design): :white_check_mark:
Sam (Events): :white_check_mark:
Nina (Legal): :white_check_mark:
ZoomBot: Reminder: SRT smoke test Jun 19 09:00 PT; dress rehearsal Jun 20 10:00 PT.
